name: the set-as-default sheet over Home

regions_read.verdict_on_region: the Home header behind the dim; names the app, not the place

regions_read.text: The fastest way to read PDF files
regions_read.verdict_on_region: unconventional position (bottom sheet); a claim about the app, not the name of a place -- dismissed

regions_read.text: PDF / HWP / Word / Excel / PPT pill row (PDF drawn filled; detector reading, no selected flag in the dump)
regions_read.verdict_on_region: a file-type filter behind the dim, not a place

identifier_found: none that names the place: the sheet heading is a slogan, the only header behind is the app's name, and the Home tab bar is covered by the sheet
accessibility_text: none -- no content_description in this state
initial_rationale: bottom sheet covers the tab bar (the only location signal on Home); its heading does not say what the sheet is

test_cases.precondition: Home open with the "Set as default reader" banner
test_cases.action: tap SET, read every visible word on the sheet and behind it, then tap Later
test_cases.expected_result: some visible text names this sheet or the place behind it, or nothing does; Later returns or does not
test_cases.confirms_if: no visible text names the sheet or the section behind it (tab bar covered, header only the app name)
test_cases.overturns_if: the sheet or the underlay carries a title naming the place
test_cases.observed_result: the sheet showed an illustration of a chooser, "The fastest way to read PDF files", "Set PDF Reader, PDF Viewer as your default app", "Set as default" and "Later"; behind it only "PDF Reader" and the filter pills were legible; the tab bar was covered; the sheet did not scroll; Later returned to Home. The sheet never states it is the set-default prompt in a heading -- only in the body sentence and button

deciding_evidence: on the live app no visible heading names the sheet or the section behind it; its purpose is only in the body sentence "Set PDF Reader, PDF Viewer as your default app" and the "Set as default" button. A modal with a clear way back (Later, verified) -- but that excuses a transition, not a screen that does not name itself. No transition verdict lands here (t10 is a touch, not evaluated)
recommendation: head the sheet "Set as default reader" -- the words already on the Home banner that opens it -- instead of "The fastest way to read PDF files"
